findings.text: The patch removes the exported `sendOneMessage` and changes the signatures of `throwOnEarlyDisconnect` (now `isSubprocess` only) and `handleSerializationError` (now positional). It also moves `forward.js` to `reference.js`. Any caller not in this diff, such as an `exchangeMessage` or `getOneMessage` module, would break. For example, `throwOnEarlyDisconnect('getOneMessage', isSubprocess)` would now treat the string `'getOneMessage'` as `isSubprocess`, which is truthy, so the error would name the wrong process. I could not check those callers because only the patch is available.
